name: Omega no Shikai -1. Shiki no Hajimari-
original_name: Omegaの視界 1.シキのはじまり
source:
A mystique visual novel for a cat, set against the backdrop of incidents in the library town.

---

Blessed be the eyes of Omega.

Alongside the self-proclaimed beautiful bookseller, Miyaoka Kadomi, the protagonist, Iikubo Makoto, set out to the rural “Mysterious Forest” up north.
There, Miyaoka assigned him to investigate a mysterious collection of documents about divine relics and local festivals that are said to have something to do with “Moon Frenzy”.   
During this investigation, he encountered a girl claiming to be his childhood friend—Kinu—and Touka, a one-eyed girl who also joined their team.

While getting swept up by his family's ambitions, what did Makoto and the two girls discover in Fuyuka’s family shrine?
Fragmented information began to emerge; his perspective kept warping.

“He is a drop that fell into a pond—a clock hand stirring mud and moving time forward.”

Ah, the cat──

P.S. Text is heavily deciphered in cryptic language, abstract ramblings, archaic words, kanji and non-kanji puns, furigana abuse. Unveiling the mystery is the aim.


[Translated from [url=https://nekobanana.com/2018/05/21/omega/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
这是一部以图书馆之城发生的事件为背景、献给猫的神秘视觉小说。

---

愿欧米伽之眼蒙受祝福。

主人公饭洼真与自称美女书商的宫冈门美一同前往北方乡间的“神秘森林”。
在那里，宫冈交给他一项调查任务：研究一批关于神圣遗物与地方祭典的神秘文献，据说这些资料与“月狂”有关。
调查过程中，他遇见了自称是自己青梅竹马的少女绢，以及后来也加入调查队伍的独眼少女冬夏。

在被家族的野心裹挟之际，真与两名少女究竟在冬夏家的神社中发现了什么？
零碎的信息开始浮现，他的视角也不断扭曲。

“他是一滴落入池塘的水——一根搅动淤泥、推动时间前行的时针。”

啊，那只猫──

附言：本文大量使用晦涩的密码式语言、抽象呓语、古语、汉字与非汉字双关，以及滥用的振假名。揭开谜团正是作品的目的。

[翻译自[url=https://nekobanana.com/2018/05/21/omega/]官方网站[/url]]
